signal: Turner Construction rolled out Clearstory's change-order platform across 350+ projects, after Clearstory's $16M Series B

email.body1:
Chris, saw Turner rolled out Clearstory across 350-plus projects after your Series B.

A marquee win like that usually opens more GC and specialty-contractor accounts than the team can work before the momentum cools, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Clearstory off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Chris, quick follow-up for Clearstory.

Post-raise and post-Turner, the pipeline target usually jumps faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Clearstory needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Chris, last bit of proof for Clearstory.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Clearstory's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B construction tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Chris, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters most right after a marquee win, and I know capitalizing on it is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a construction tech motion? I will tailor it to Clearstory either way.
